description: Authored controls opened and saved in the native reference application, 2026-09-19. Same semantic tree as diagram-layout-fixture.js. Native regenerated model IDs normalized by parOf graph positions. Root has lin algorithm, empty shape/presOf/constraint list, and 400x100mm frame. Geometry and mappings prove replacement of active properties; varLst uses its first direct occurrence.
